name: Los Angeles County Fish and Wildlife Commission grants

funder.name: Los Angeles County Fish and Wildlife Commission

summary: Grants from a county fund fed by wildlife-law fines, for non-profits running fish and wildlife propagation, protection, restoration, research and education projects. Applicants present their request in person at a quarterly Commission meeting.

geography.label: Los Angeles County, California (funds may be spent within or outside the County)

steps: Submit the application by email or post
Present the request in person at a scheduled Commission meeting

eligibility.rule: A non-profit with 501(c)(3) status or a purpose consistent with it
The project qualifies under Section 13103 of the California Fish and Wildlife Code.

status.quote: The Commission meets quarterly but grant applications may be submitted at any time.

applicant_types.quote: Non-profit organizations with an IRS 501 (c) (3) tax-exempt status or a purpose consistent with the definition of 501 (c) (3) status are eligible to apply.

geography.quote: Projects funded under this Section must be expended for the propagation and conservation of fish and game within or outside the County.

access.quote: All applicants must attend and present their grant requests in-person at a scheduled Commission meeting, to have their grant request considered.

window.quote: The Commission meets quarterly but grant applications may be submitted at any time.
